name: ai-agent-skills-library
description: A versioned, code-reviewed library of agentic AI skills, sub-agents, runbooks, prompts, and installers. Works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, OpenCode, Cowork, and Antigravity. Skills follow the open Agent Skills specification and stay portable across organizations via brand-config.yml.

plugins.name: agent-foundation
plugins.description: Operating principles + design methodology + voice + autonomy playbook + brand SSOT precedence. Load these on every project. Together they make any AI tool act as an institutional agent rather than a chat toy: signal over noise, anti-sycophancy, on-brand voice, multi-disciplinary design discipline, strategic tool-fire decisions, brand canon precedence.

plugins.name: content-engine
plugins.description: Newsletter, social, and brand-drift skills. Drafts content from RSS + voice playbook, scans recently-shipped content for voice drift, never publishes without review-channel approval. Configure via brand-config.yml.

plugins.name: ops-pipeline
plugins.description: Inbound triage, calendar scheduling, pipeline reporting, competitive monitoring. Reads your CRM / calendar / inbox, drafts what humans should review, never auto-actions. Configure via brand-config.yml.

plugins.name: agent-self-improvement
plugins.description: Weekly meta-review where the agent proposes updates to its own system prompt based on observed patterns + your corrections. Compounds voice fidelity over time.

plugins.name: agency-agents
plugins.description: 16 specialist sub-agents cherry-picked from msitarzewski/agency-agents (MIT). Auto-route on natural-language triggers via 'Use PROACTIVELY when...' phrases. Coverage: engineering (ai-engineer, sre, code-reviewer, incident-response-commander, database-optimizer, autonomous-optimization-architect), orchestration (agents-orchestrator, workflow-architect, agentic-identity-trust, identity-graph-operator), content (linkedin-content-creator, carousel-growth-engine, ai-citation-strategist, document-generator), visual + production gate (image-prompt-engineer, reality-checker). Voice-aware agents defer to project brand voice playbook via the brand-ssot-precedence skill.
